title: Initializing and Managing a Swarm knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Initializing and Managing a Swarm”?
options: Initialize Swarm on a shared production Engine to learn the commands.
Use Compose and Swarm as exact equivalents for multi-node scheduling.
Share join tokens in public logs.
Treat Swarm as an optional cluster orchestration mode and operate on an isolated test cluster.
questions.answer_key: Treat Swarm as an optional cluster orchestration mode and operate on an isolated test cluster.
questions.explanation: Swarm includes cluster management and overlay networking; learning cluster changes should be isolated.

questions.prompt: For a lab covering initializing and managing a swarm, what is the strongest evidence of learning?
options: Make several unrelated changes before collecting a baseline.
Use a production host so the result looks realistic.
Record the command or configuration, predicted result, observed evidence, and one relevant edge case.
Assume the command is portable and skip reading its output.
questions.answer_key: Record the command or configuration, predicted result, observed evidence, and one relevant edge case.
questions.explanation: A useful lab connects a predicted result to actual output and checks an edge case. This is safer and more reproducible than assuming success.

questions.prompt: If an example related to initializing and managing a swarm fails, which response is best?
options: Trust the image tag without inspecting the image or version.
Reproduce the issue, inspect state/logs/configuration, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify the fix.
Delete every stopped container and unused volume before investigating.
Disable permissions or security controls until the example works.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the issue, inspect state/logs/configuration, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify the fix.
questions.explanation: The evidence-led approach keeps the diagnosis reproducible and avoids hiding the cause. For initializing and managing a swarm, verify the fix with the exact setting or command that failed.
